title: C Syntax & Control Flow
summary: Primitives, arithmetic, I/O functions, conditional branching, iteration constructs (while, for loops).

title: Functions, Pointers & Memory
summary: Function stack frames, recursion, pointer arithmetic, dynamic memory allocation (malloc, free), array-pointer duality.

title: Propositional & Predicate Logic
summary: Truth tables, logical equivalences, normal forms (CNF/DNF), universal and existential quantifiers, proof by induction.

title: Combinatorics & Graph Theory
summary: Pigeonhole principle, inclusion-exclusion, recurrence relations, graph representations, Euler and Hamiltonian paths, planar graphs.

title: Linear Structures & Sorting
summary: Dynamic arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, amortized analysis, comparison sorts and non-comparison sorting.

title: Hierarchical Structures & Graphs
summary: Binary trees, AVL trees, Red-Black balance invariants, binary heaps, disjoint-set union, BFS and DFS traversals.

title: Processor Datapath & ALU
summary: Register transfer language, arithmetic logic unit circuits, instruction encoding, assembly programming.

title: Pipelining & Memory Subsystems
summary: 5-stage RISC pipeline, structural/data/control hazards, branch prediction, direct-mapped and set-associative caches.

title: Greedy & Dynamic Programming Paradigms
summary: Optimal substructure, overlapping subproblems, memoization vs tabulation, knapsack, LCS, matrix chain multiplication.

title: Advanced Graph Algorithms & Intractability
summary: Shortest paths (Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford), Max Flow (Ford-Fulkerson, Edmonds-Karp), NP-completeness proofs and reductions.

title: Regular Languages & Finite Automata
summary: DFA, NFA, epsilon transitions, subset construction, regular expressions, pumping lemma for regular languages.

title: Computability & Turing Machines
summary: Context-free grammars, pushdown automata, Turing machines, halting problem undecidability, Rice's theorem.

title: CPU Scheduling & Virtual Memory
summary: Process state lifecycle, PCB, context switching, round robin/MLFQ, multilevel page tables, TLBs, clock page replacement.

title: Concurrency & Storage Systems
summary: POSIX threads, mutexes, condition variables, semaphores, deadlock detection, disk scheduling, inode-based file systems.

title: Scanning & Parsing
summary: Lexical tokens, regular expressions to DFA, LL(1) parse tables, LR(0), SLR(1), LALR(1) parsing algorithms using Yacc/Bison.

title: Optimization & Code Generation
summary: Static Single Assignment (SSA) form, dead code elimination, loop invariant code motion, register allocation via graph coloring.

title: Relational Modeling & Query Languages
summary: ER to relational schema mapping, tuple and domain relational calculus, relational algebra operators, complex SQL queries.

title: Normalization & Transaction Recovery
summary: Armstrong's axioms, 3NF synthesis, BCNF decomposition, strict two-phase locking, ARIES write-ahead logging.

title: Heuristic Search & Adversarial Games
summary: Admissible and consistent heuristics, A* optimality, alpha-beta minimax pruning, constraint satisfaction with AC-3.

title: Probabilistic Reasoning & Reinforcement Learning
summary: Bayesian networks, d-separation, variable elimination, Markov decision processes, Bellman optimality, tabular Q-learning.

title: Transport Protocols & Congestion Management
summary: TCP 3-way handshake, sliding window flow control, congestion window dynamics (AIMD, slow start, fast recovery, BBR).

title: Internet Routing & Data Link Technologies
summary: CIDR, IPv4/IPv6 headers, link-state vs distance-vector routing, BGP peering, Ethernet CSMA/CD, Wi-Fi 802.11 CSMA/CA.

title: LLM Interfaces & Structured Tool Calling
summary: Prompt patterns for software engineering, JSON schema enforcement, function calling registries, deterministic parsing.

title: Agentic Workflows & Safety Sandboxing
summary: ReAct execution loops, multi-step error recovery, trace logging, human-in-the-loop approvals, sandboxed command execution.
